phase_a.objective_rationale: 50 evaluation defaults gives illustrative rare-event CITL halfwidth ~0.28 rather than ~0.88 at five; AUC halfwidth at assumed 0.8 ~0.07 rather than ~0.23. Development 150 supplies materially more support for later modest fixed models. Neither threshold is a validity/regulatory minimum; dependence and calibration slope still require empirical validation.
